notes.title: Version 9.9.8 is available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today I have updated the version to 9.9.8, the issues fixed in this update are:


 Time zone updated as we move from one to another.
  UTC Time does not change as we move from place to place.


Enjoy !

Ilan

notes.title: Version 9.9.6 is here
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Today I have released version 9.9.6 on Steam, the main changes and updates in this version are:


 Added wave length control for waves options.
 Docking dialog has two modes, anchoring and docking.
 Added viscosity setting for ships.
 Auto zoom turned off for F5 view.
 Fixed overlapping text on main screen.
 Added dgruddr, dgturn instruments.
 Added rudder delay in vehicle.cfg [controls_delay]
 Controls_delay set by ship size unless appears in vehicle.cfg.


I hope you enjoy this version, if there is any problem please email me directly.

Thanks !

Ilan

notes.title: Virtual Sailor NG 9.9.4 is here
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Today I have released version 9.9.4 of Virtual Sailor NG, in this version the following features were added:


 Added NMEA sentence $GPGLL.
 Fixed bug in $GPRMC command.
 Added Conning display dialog.
 Added external view of conning display.
 Added conning digital instrument.
 Optimized source lights.
 Fixed some tooltips on options dialog.


Note, the Conning dialog has also a keyboard shortcut, it is not set by default, you need to set it using Options->Keyboard.

I hope you enjoy this update,

Thanks,

Ilan

notes.title: Version 9.9.2 is here
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,


Today I have released version 9.9.2 of Virtual Sailor NG, in this version the following changes were made:
Added Freeze Motion button for freezing a ship while docked.
Saving Freeze state when a ship is docked.
Fixed buttons state on dock dialogs when dock screen attached to panel.
Ctrl+F3,F4 Allowing simulations rates less than 1.
Fixed loading cars onto decks, and saving their positions in situations.
Fixed vehicles positions change when moving from scenery to scenery.
Light sources on ships disappear bug fixed.


As always, please support the development of this program by buying when needed and not using pirated copies...

More updates are coming,

Thanks !

Ilan

notes.title: Virtual Sailor NG 9.9.0 is here
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is the update to version 9.9.9, in this update the following features and bug fixed were made:



 Capture the joystick always as we have external windows.
 Fixed date change issue, year can be 2005 or up.
 Fixed change time to now where there are negative numbers.
 Moon can be seen during the day.
 Added the views dialog to vehicle dialog and add keyboard shortcut.
 Added wind and current mini panel to the map.
 Current speed and direction saved in situation.



I hope you all enjoy this update !

Thanks,

Ilan

notes.title: Virtual Sailor NG 9.8.8 is here
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is the update to version 9.8.8, in this update the following features and bug fixed were made:


Saving sails positions and auto_sail state in situation.
Fixed motion update for windmills, winsocks and windvanes.
Fixed bug when body broken exists cannot see body simple.
Allow negative values in doors_angle, doors_move, sweeps_angle, folds_angle.
Get real weather will set real time also using correct time zone.
Added rudder angle on panels.
Added button to pause/resume animations on the parts dialog.
Fixed bug with animations and propellers update speed.
Animation state is sent by netplay and also stored in replay.
External views are resiable and more adapted to multiple views.
Fixed speed over water for boats with elements under current.
Added Traffic vehicles, and traffic vehicle screen.
Fixed date change issue, year can be set to 2005 or up.
 Fixed set time to now, where there were negative hour values due to negative time zone.


I hope you all enjoy this update !

Thanks,

Ilan
